source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To clarify, although I mentioned presenting still frames as a digital comic book, I want to attempt the animation first. I’ll fall back to the digital comic book with still frames only if the animation produces poor results or proves too difficult or expensive.

routing_warnings.description: The client expresses uncertainty about attaining acceptable animation quality and conditions further testing or investment on confidence in that quality; the message does not clearly change animation's status as the preferred primary medium.
